reviews.author: Sean
reviews.text:
First time eating from this food chain but has heard about it.  I went before dinner peak hours kicked, at 530 pm and the queue was short with only two people in front.

Food was tasty and good.

Although the grilled fish was kinda overly soft

Waited maybe below 10 mins for the food to be ready.

I didn't use their electronic kiosk ordering machines but ordered directly and paid via physical QR code that supports a number of payment merchants.

31 Oct 2026.  I came again.  At 7 pm, grilled fish was already sold out.  I got the chicken chop with pasta.  The English of the Indian man was a bit hard to understand.  I believed he asked me oilo or tomato.  I had the tomato.

Food was reasonably nice.  Quantity a bit small though.  Just a single small piece of chicken

reviews.author: Ray Tan
reviews.text: Western for 5 bux..no kidding. Halal certified somemore. Tried their chix chop. Nth fanciful. Just the chix, a bun and a relatively generous portion of fries. I actually quite like the fries though. It’s fresh and crispy. The chix chop is slightly smaller than usual but tasted alright. The brown sauce is fairly decent, not too watery. Overall can’t complain la. Can try if ur on a budget but still want to satisfy ur chix chop cravings.

reviews.author: Alwayshangry
reviews.text:
It's hard to come by a plate of Western food that costs just SGD 5 these days.

I ordered their grilled chicken chop and requested for the sauce to be served separately. The meal came with a fried bun, shoestring fries, and coleslaw.

The grilled chicken was nicely charred, while the fried bun brought back nostalgic memories with its old-school taste that I grew up with.

Overall, it's a simple yet satisfying plate of comfort food that offers great value for money.

For just SGD 5, it's definitely worth a try if you're looking for an affordable and comforting meal.

reviews.author: Leona
reviews.text:
The basket used for the chicken is disgusting..see for yourself..I only saw it after finishing my food 😅

Ordered chicken chop and fried chicken (half). Food was ok though the fried chicken took ~10mins and the person don’t even inform me - via the beeper

reviews.author: Danial Alfian
reviews.text:
Ordered the chicken chop, fried fish and the platter with finger foods! Chicken chop is usually good but today taste a bit off, the fish however was so good! Satisfied my cravings and doesn’t have that fishy smelly taste when you get cheap fish.

My only issue was the finger foods. Onion rings and chix popcorn was good But, the coleslaw, chicken nuggets were just off. Tasted a bit weird and I think they should change it. Cheap so you can’t really complain ig? For $5, I think it’s basic done well

reviews.author: Rahmat Hashim
reviews.text:
Had a pleasant dining experience at Batter Catch, VivoCity.

Special thanks to Fiqa for her attentive and friendly service. She was warm, approachable and made sure we were well taken care of throughout our visit.

It’s always refreshing to receive such genuine hospitality. Great service makes all the difference and Fiqa certainly made our experience an enjoyable one.

Keep up the excellent work! Highly recommended. 👏

reviews.author: GAT-X105 STRIKE GUNDAM
reviews.text:
Service was good. Staff was attentive however they should probably provide a queue to designate the line as some people were using the mall seats to “book” the queue.

For the food, we ordered the Fish and Chips with the curry sauce. Overall it tasted good, the homemade curry sauce sealed the deal for me. With that being said, the fries were average.

We also ordered the Truffle Mac and Cheese. Tastes good although I felt that they crammed way too many mushrooms into the  mac and cheese.

The price is generally okay for where it is. Overall, pleasant dinner experience. Will come again.

reviews.author: Kathleen Rimpang
reviews.text: Service was quick and fast. The wait staff, Krishan was attentive to our needs. The kids ordered tea not realizing it was hot tea. Krishan offered to have the tea with ice. Excellent and food was equally as good!👍🏻 👍🏻

reviews.author: Nic
reviews.text: Wait staff was extremely accommodating, took the time to explain to my friends and I what was available despite it being peak hours. Was happy to take requests for adjustments to food due to my medical needs as well. Overall price was quite worth it as well, and the food was filling. Though the dory was a touch dry but still tasty.

reviews.author: Jennifer Phua
reviews.text: Staff asked if we have any allergy, also asked how’s our food, which I replied that the outer layer of the rosti was a bit burnt, was asked if I would like another, which I rejected as the food was still acceptable. Another staff asked us how’s the food when clearing the plates, which I replied the same. She later came to inform us that they would serve us a complimentary dessert, which was the ice-cream shown in the photo. We did not ask for any form of compensation, merely gave feedback when asked how’s the food, so we were delighted with the service, particularly service recovery. Would definitely come again & recommend this place, thumb up!

reviews.author: Umai mai1
reviews.text: I was trying to pick up my order I just want to check my order if its correct then this guy just scold me he say my order number “725! Faster take n go” i understand it is busy but I expect better customer service from you. Just because we are students doesn’t mean you can treat us this way. I hope this will be taken to consideration and that the management will advice the staffs to have better customer service

reviews.author: Elaine
reviews.text: I LOVE U YATI I LOVE U IKA!!!! super duper friendly staff members and good service, BEST POTATO CORNER OAT 💯

reviews.author: Shayan
reviews.text: I ordered chicken winglets. Picked it up at the counter. Sat down. Started to eat. The crust was warm. The meat close to the bone was cold.

reviews.author: amy
reviews.text:
As a long-time Potato Corner supporter who genuinely enjoys and frequently purchases from the brand, this experience was especially disappointing and disheartening.

I made payment for my order and the money was deducted from my account, yet the machine prompted me to pay again and did not provide any receipt or confirmation. When I approached the cashier for assistance, she checked briefly, told me that my order was not in the system, and walked away without offering any explanation or attempting to help resolve the issue.

What upset me most was not the payment error itself, as technical issues can happen anywhere, but the way the situation was handled. As a paying customer who was simply trying to understand what had happened to my money, I expected at least some level of empathy, professionalism, or willingness to assist. Instead, I was left confused, ignored, and uncertain about whether my payment had gone through.

As someone who has always supported Potato Corner and looked forward to buying from the brand, this experience was genuinely saddening. It is disappointing when a place you enjoy leaves you feeling dismissed rather than valued as a customer. I hope management takes customer service more seriously, as a little effort to help and communicate would have made a significant difference.

reviews.author: shanica
reviews.text:
How do i even begin this horror story….
My dear friend and I, Amy, just finished our presentation. Our heels and flats were hurting, blisters all over our feet. however, we sucked it up and walked to get a nice meal from potato corner. We queued and ordered, but when it came to our payment… the machine took Amy’s money and the order didn’t go through. The beautiful Malay aunty at the cashier told us the order didn’t go through and she could not do anything. My poor Amy, this store has scammed us for far too long!! Do something about this NYP Potato Corner😢

reviews.author: Laura L
reviews.text:
Our family enjoyed the zi char here! Everything was tasty and the price was ok. It's an outdoor seating area next to the prawning pools. There are some portable aircon fans which keep the area comfortable. We will be back again, hopefully to try some of their other dishes or mookata. Stand out dishes were the curry fish head (very yummy! We added more taukee to ours) and the prawn paste chicken wings. All other dishes were also good. The food came out really fast as well! We were impressed.

Bathrooms were surprisingly large and clean, so that is a bonus for sure.

reviews.author: Bli Leong
reviews.text:
Food was tasty with very flavourful dips and sauces. And prices are very reasonable and cheap.
The only complain is you have to eat in  very hot, stifling and non-airy environment.

reviews.author: Jen Koh
reviews.text:
Hear me out, brothers and sisters. This is hands down my favourite mookata place and honestly, the best I’ve had 😋👍

For the mookata, the meats are super well marinated, soup is very flavourful, quality is consistently good every visit! If you come here in a big group, you can also order zichar (within the same restaurant). We tried the salted egg pork ribs super solid!! must order with rice. Bet I’m coming back with a bigger group to try all other zichar dishes!

The atmosphere is lively and comfortable, service is great, and one huge plus is the ample parking available.

Best of all, the prices are very affordable for the quality and portion sizes. Highly recommend to anyone looking for amazing food and great value!

reviews.author: Alvin Chan
reviews.text:
New place here that they moved to.  Nice cosy environment for prawning, mookata and zhi char.

We had zhi char dishes today, but they should time dishes accordingly like having the cold dish plater first and not be the last dish with desserts.

Otherwise, generally ok.

reviews.author: Chintiong Teo
reviews.text: Located at the ORTO RC at West Coast,the place was surprisingly rather quiet when we arrived at 8pm on a Saturday evening. Spread of the marinated meat and stuff for Mookata experience was kinda usual and price was reasonable. A place that I will not think of for Mookata in the near future unless someone else suggesting it.

reviews.author: Ak 47
reviews.text:
Great Local Coffeeshop

M38 Jalan Pemimpin is a nice neighbourhood canteen coffeeshop with a good variety of food and drinks. The atmosphere is casual and comfortable, making it a convenient place to grab a meal, have a coffee, or meet up with friends and family.

The food choices are reasonably priced, portions are satisfying, and the overall experience is pleasant. I also like the convenient location and relaxed local  atmosphere.

A good place for a simple and affordable meal in the Jalan Pemimpin area. Definitely worth supporting our local and the hardworking stall owners!

reviews.author: Rebekka Roßberg
reviews.text: Having tried all kinds of dumplings in Europe and Asia I am firmly convinced that these are the best of them all! Perfectly cooked skin every time (I've eaten here way over 20 times) and just the PERFECT ratio of meat and veggies inside. Can't wait to come back here!

reviews.author: Stephanie Ow
reviews.text: Jia Wei Noodle delivers an exceptional bowl every time. The broth tastes good and comforting, the handmade noodles are perfectly chewy, and the ingredients are consistently fresh. Every bite reflects quality and care, making it a must-visit spot for authentic, satisfying ban mian. Highly recommended for all noodle lovers working near this industrial area.

reviews.author: 吴思蕾Agnes
reviews.text: I ended work really late and was glad to see this mini foodcourt and this stall still opened, and ordered dumplings. Each piece was big and tasted pretty alright, though the skin was indeed too thick and dry. But overall, a plate of 10 big filling dumplings at &6.50 in this day and age is really quite affordable. Not a bad choice for those working nearby. Thank you to the stall lady for willing to serve me even though she was closing!

reviews.author: R Ching
reviews.text: Used to like eating their Tomyum Koka noodle. Ever since the new hire auntie cook the standard dropped. Gave her 2 chances. Cant even cook the koka noodle properly, still so hard, uncooked
